mapper.select: SELECT id,project_code,project_name FROM pm_project WHERE id=#{projectId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pm_project WHERE id=#{projectId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0

SELECT s.physical_subsystem_id AS id,p.code,COALESCE(NULLIF(p.short_name,''),REPLACE(p.name,'物理子系统','')) AS name,p.short_name FROM tm_test_participating_system s JOIN arch_physical_subsystem p ON p.id=s.physical_subsystem_id AND p.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND p.deleted=0 WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.test_domain=#{domain} AND s.project_id=#{projectId} AND s.enabled=1 AND s.deleted=0 ORDER BY p.code,p.id

SELECT s.id,s.node_name,s.updated_at,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_plan p WHERE p.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND p.test_domain=s.test_domain AND p.project_id=s.project_id AND p.special_node_id=s.id AND p.deleted=0) AS plan_count FROM tm_test_plan_special_node s WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.test_domain=#{domain} AND s.project_id=#{projectId} AND s.deleted=0 ORDER BY s.node_name,s.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_plan WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND node_type=#{nodeType} AND deleted=0

SELECT p.id,p.plan_name,p.updated_at,v.id AS version_id,v.version_no,v.version_note,v.attachment_id,v.file_name,v.file_extension,v.file_size,v.uploaded_by,v.created_at AS uploaded_at,(SELECT u.display_name FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id=v.uploaded_by AND u.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND u.deleted=0) AS uploader_name FROM tm_test_plan p JOIN tm_test_plan_version v ON v.id=(SELECT x.id FROM tm_test_plan_version x WHERE x.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND x.plan_id=p.id AND x.deleted=0 ORDER BY x.version_no DESC,x.id DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND p.test_domain=#{domain} AND p.project_id=#{projectId} AND p.node_type=#{nodeType} AND p.deleted=0 ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC,p.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{size}

SELECT v.id AS version_id,v.version_no,v.version_note,v.attachment_id,v.file_name,v.file_extension,v.file_size,v.uploaded_by,v.created_at AS uploaded_at,(SELECT u.display_name FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id=v.uploaded_by AND u.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND u.deleted=0) AS uploader_name FROM tm_test_plan_version v WHERE v.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND v.plan_id=#{planId} AND v.deleted=0 ORDER BY v.version_no DESC,v.id DESC
